description: Unofficial Medic fan-art companion inspired by Team Fortress 2. Original animation features toy stethoscope checks on a wooden doll, a decorative plant lamp, sealed empty display-tube sorting, gentle recovery and articulated three-direction jogging. Fully clothed RED-team-inspired costume; props are nonfunctional and no real medical treatment is depicted. Not affiliated with Valve.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
